void.string: 付款方式空值初始化路由验证

<metadata> <extendSimpleProperty name="fd_fkfs" type="String" enumValues="电汇|A;票据|B;其他|C"/> <extendSimpleProperty name="fd_pjlx" type="String"/> <extendSimpleProperty name="fd_zffs" type="String"/> </metadata>

<xform:select property="extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_fkfs)" showPleaseSelect="true" onValueChange="__xformDispatch">
    <xform:simpleDataSource value="A">电汇</xform:simpleDataSource>
    <xform:simpleDataSource value="B">票据</xform:simpleDataSource>
    <xform:simpleDataSource value="C">其他</xform:simpleDataSource>
   </xform:select>
   <script>
    Com_AddEventListener(window, "load", function() {
      var is_ywzd = GetXFormFieldById("fd_fkfs")[0];
      if (is_ywzd.value.indexOf("B") >= 0) {
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("pjlx_row", true, false, false);
      } else {
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("pjlx_row", false, false, false);
      }
    });
    Com_AddEventListener(window, "load", function() {
      var is_ywzd = GetXFormFieldById("fd_fkfs")[0];
      if (is_ywzd.value.indexOf("B") >= 0) {
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("zffs_row", true, false, false);
      } else {
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("zffs_row", false, false, false);
      }
    });
   </script>
